snippet.title: POPUCOM | PS5 Launch Date Trailer
snippet.description:
POPUCOM is coming to PlayStation 5 on November 17th!

Get ready to dive into the vibrant co-op puzzle-platformer in couch co-op and online multiplayer, coming soon to PlayStation 5!

Wishlist POPUCOM on PS5: https://store.playstation.com/en-gb/concept/10009072/

ABOUT POPUCOM

POPUCOM is a multiplayer co-op adventure where players team up to save a mysterious planet using colour switching, match-3 shooting, platforming challenges, and creative teamwork. Explore a two-player Story Mode full of puzzles and enemies, or jump into Party Mode for 3–4 player mayhem with rapid-fire mini-games and team-based trials.
